_comment: Standard stages scaffolded as sub-issues under every issue labelled idea or epic. Single source for tracker.py, the tracker GitHub Action and the shape/ship skills. Edit here, never in copies.

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.goal: Decide whether this is worth doing, and when.
checklist: Problem and who it is for, in two or three sentences
How it works today (code and spec references), if it touches existing features
Rough size (S / M / L / XL), risks and dependencies
Recommendation: go, park or drop, with reasons, posted as a comment
Owner decision (needs-owner) when it is a product call rather than an obvious yes

stages.name: Explore alternatives
stages.goal: Find two or three genuinely different ways to do it and pick one.
checklist: Two or three options with trade-offs (UX, effort, risk, what it rules out later)
Mockups or sketches for anything visual, in dark and light themes
A recommendation, and the owner's pick (needs-owner)
Decision record in docs/decisions/ for the chosen option
stages.skippable: Close with a one-line reason when there is only one sensible approach.

stages.name: Specify
stages.goal: Write the detailed design so implementation needs no guessing.
checklist: Spec section in docs/ written or updated, with the tracking line (epic #N, Status: approved)
Screens, states (empty, loading, error, offline), data, formulas and tokens covered
Task sub-issues created under the Implement stage, each with acceptance criteria and tests
Task dependencies noted as 'Blocked by #N'

stages.name: Implement
stages.goal: Build it. The actual work lives in task sub-issues of this stage.
checklist: Every task sub-issue closed via the ship skill (code, tests, gate, spec kept true)
Backend changes deployed through the supabase-deploy skill
Deferred or discovered work filed as new issues

stages.name: Verify & release
stages.goal: Prove it works end to end and close the loop.
checklist: Acceptance criteria of the epic checked against the running app
E2E, golden and accessibility coverage at the right pyramid level
Dark and light themes checked; device run filed as a human-only issue if needed
Spec tracking line set to Status: shipped; docs/ROADMAP.md updated
Short summary for the owner posted on the epic
